one_liner.value: HubSpot offers OAuth2 and bearer token REST APIs for CRM data.
one_liner.quote: Get started free with HubSpot's free tools

subcategory.quote: You use the object APIs to create and manage an object’s records.

gating_notes.value: OAuth is required for multi‑tenant apps; a developer must create an app, set distribution (marketplace or private), and have a user install it to obtain tokens.
gating_notes.quote: If you plan to distribute your app to multiple accounts ... your app must be built using OAuth authentication. ... set the `distribution` property to `marketplace` or `private`.

oauth_details.value: Create an app, generate an install URL with client_id, redirect_uri, scopes; user authorizes, HubSpot redirects with a code; exchange code for access and refresh tokens; use Bearer header for API calls.
oauth_details.quote: After a user authorizes your app ... you can use it to generate an access token and a refresh token. The access token will be used to authenticate requests ... using the `Bearer` HTTP authorization header.

auth_methods.quote: OAuth is required for multiple accounts, while static auth access tokens are used for installing in a single account at a time.

primary_auth.quote: If you plan to distribute your app to multiple accounts ... your app must be built using OAuth authentication.
